title: Ruby Ruiz, Vic del Rosario, Hilda Koronel among honorees at PH Film Industry Month ceremonies
summary: The Philippine Film Industry Month ended their month-long celebration by giving recognition to movies, actors and production outfits who continue to make the local film industry thriving and alive.
